head.title: How can we help?
head.body: Choose the quickest route: apply online, contact the right team, or ask the route finder to point you there.

routeFinder.title: Start with what you need.
routeFinder.body: Most people can act faster from one of these routes. If you are not sure, use the route finder and it will highlight the right contact option.

assistant.title: Not sure who to contact?
assistant.body: Tell the route finder what you need help with. It can suggest the right route, then you can still call, text, email, or apply online yourself.

options.title: Start or continue an application
options.body: Use the online form if you want a personalised quote or are ready to apply.

options.title: You are struggling with repayments
options.body: Go straight to the repayment support team if paying is becoming difficult.

options.title: Update details or settle your loan
options.body: Use the existing-loan route for settlement figures, account updates, or loan support.

options.title: You want to ask before applying
options.body: Use the new-loan team for application questions that are not covered by the form.

options.title: Make or follow up a complaint
options.body: Use the complaints page if something has gone wrong and you want it handled formally.

channels.title: Taking out a new loan?
channels.note: Please include your full name when emailing.

channels.title: Struggling with repayments?
channels.note: If you’re in difficulty, reach out — ignoring the problem only makes it worse.

channels.title: Update details or settle your loan?
channels.note: For settlements, include your full name and ‘SETTLEMENT’ in your message.

debtAdvice.title: Independent debt advice
debtAdvice.bodyHtml: Free, impartial help is available from StepChange on 0800 138 1111 and MoneyHelper on 0800 138 7777.
